format: Perl script with embedded ARM assembly code
description: This file contains Perl code that generates ARM assembly routines for GHASH operations optimized for ARMv8 Crypto Extensions, supporting both 32-bit and 64-bit modes. It includes functions for initializing precomputed tables, performing multiplication, and hashing, specifically tailored for the GHASH algorithm used in cryptography.

methods.name: gcm_init_v8
methods.description: Initializes the precomputed table for GHASH with twisted H values and their powers for optimized multiplication.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_v8
methods.description: Performs multiplication of the current hash value with the precomputed H table in GHASH.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_v8
methods.description: Computes the GHASH over input data, updating the hash value.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_v8_4x
methods.description: A 4x parallel version of GHASH for improved performance on ARMv8.
